Solution written to `/workspace/solution.md`. --- # Fix: CI "Verify committed PRD artifacts are current" fails — generated artifact stale vs. its generator **Problem class:** `ci-generated-artifacts-stale-vs-generator` **Recurrence:** tatara `TAT-077` (2026-10-06), again `INT-CI-20261101` (2026-11-01) **Canonical case:** `docs/prd/tatara-PRD.html` drifted from `scripts/merge-prd.py`; deterministic 3-line nested-`` diff. ## 1. Symptom A GitHub Actions job fails at the step **"Verify committed PRD artifacts are current"** with an annotation shaped like: ``` docs/prd/tatara-PRD.html artifacts are stale: scripts/merge-prd.py regenerated them ``` The source tree looks untouched, the PR is small or empty, and the failing check is the *same* check that passed on `main` — until now. The job is doing exactly what it should: it runs the canonical generator and fails if the working tree differs from the committed artifacts. ## 2. Root cause The committed generated artifact drifted from the canonical generator output. The gate cannot know *why* the bytes differ; it only knows `regenerate != committed`. Drift happens in one of two ways: 1. **Hand reformat / manual edit** of the generated HTML committed without re-running the generator. Here the edit introduced nested `…` markup — a deterministic rendering difference in the Markdown→HTML pipeline (`python-markdown` with `toc`/`tables`/`attr_list`), not a flaky render. 2. **A source commit that landed while hosted CI was down** (billing / runner outage). The commit touched the generator or its inputs, but the regen gate never screened it, so the artifact was committed one revision behind. Identifying properties: - **Deterministic, not nondeterministic.** The generator hits the *same* diff every time. It cannot be "re-run to green". - **Scope is narrow.** The diff is confined to generated artifacts; the source `.md` files are byte-identical. - **Process gap, not a code bug.** `committed artifact == generator(source)` was violated at commit time. Generator and verify step are both correct. ### Why it recurs The invariant is enforced only by CI. Any path that bypasses CI (hosted runner outage, `--no-verify`, a hotfix push, a merge that skipped the gate) can land a commit where the generator source and its outputs are out of sync. The recurrence-class rule: > Any commit that touches a generator source **or** its generated outputs must run the generator and commit the regenerated outputs **in the same commit**. ## 3. Diagnose before fixing Do **not** hand-edit the HTML to "match CI". Reproduce, then commit the generator's own output. ### 3.1 Find the exact generator invocation the CI step uses ```bash rg -n -i "Verify committed PRD artifacts are current" .github/workflows rg -n -A 25 -i "artifacts are stale|merge-prd" .github/workflows ``` The verify step typically looks like: ```yaml - name: Verify committed PRD artifacts are current run: | python scripts/merge-prd.py if ! git diff --quiet -- docs/prd; then echo "docs/prd/... artifacts are stale: scripts/merge-prd.py regenerated them" git --no-pager diff -- docs/prd exit 1 fi ``` ### 3.2 Reproduce deterministically (proves drift, not flake) ```bash cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" source .venv/bin/activate # or: uv sync && source .venv/bin/activate python scripts/merge-prd.py git --no-pager diff -- docs/prd git checkout -- docs/prd python scripts/merge-prd.py git --no-pager diff -- docs/prd # identical -> deterministic drift ``` If the two diffs are identical, it is this class. If they differ run-to-run, stop: that is generator nondeterminism (pin versions, sort iteration order). ### 3.3 Confirm the diff is scoped to the artifacts ```bash git status --short git diff --stat -- 'docs/prd/*.md' # expect: empty ``` Expected: `M docs/prd/tatara-PRD.html` only. ## 4. Exact fix Do **not** touch the source `.md`. ```bash set -euo pipefail cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" # 0. Same interpreter/venv as CI. source .venv/bin/activate # or: uv run # 1. Regenerate ALL generated PRD artifacts from their canonical source. python scripts/merge-prd.py # 2. Safety check: diff must be limited to generated artifacts, source .md untouched. if ! git diff --quiet -- 'docs/prd/*.md'; then echo "ERROR: source markdown changed — this is a content change, not stale-artifact drift." >&2 git --no-pager diff -- 'docs/prd/*.md' exit 1 fi git status --short # expect only generated .html files # 3. Commit the regenerated artifact(s). git add docs/prd git commit -m "chore(prd): regenerate docs/prd/tatara-PRD.html from scripts/merge-prd.py Committed artifact drifted from canonical generator output (nested-strong markup, deterministic 3-line diff). Regenerated with the project venv. Recurrence class: ci-generated-artifacts-stale-vs-generator." ``` Only the generator's bytes will ever pass the gate. Hand-patching the HTML guarantees failure on the next render. ### If the drift came from a source commit that landed during a CI outage Keep the (correct) source change and regenerate in that same logical fix. Never split "source edit" and "regenerated output" across two commits — that is what caused the incident. ## 5. Verification ### 5.1 Local idempotence (required before claiming done) ```bash cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" source .venv/bin/activate python scripts/merge-prd.py if git diff --quiet -- docs/prd; then echo "OK: idempotent — regenerating produces no diff" else echo "FAIL: generator is not idempotent" >&2 git --no-pager diff -- docs/prd exit 1 fi git status --short # expect: clean ``` This proves the committed bytes are a fixed point of the generator. ### 5.2 Exact-head CI confirmation ```bash git rev-parse HEAD git push gh run list --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --limit 5 gh run watch "$(gh run list --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --json databaseId \ -q '.[0].databaseId')" ``` Done criteria: - [ ] `python scripts/merge-prd.py` leaves `git diff -- docs/prd` empty **after** the fix commit. - [ ] The fix commit's diff contains only generated artifacts (no `.md` changes). - [ ] The GitHub Actions run on the fix commit's exact SHA shows **"Verify committed PRD artifacts are current"** green. - [ ] A follow-up regen in a clean checkout is a no-op. ### 5.3 Reproduction used to validate this runbook Exercised on a minimal replica (generator → committed hand-reformatted HTML with nested `` inside ``): ```text verify step (pre-fix): FAIL: ... artifacts are stale: scripts/merge-prd.py regenerated them diff scope: M docs/prd/tatara-PRD.html (source .md: none) fix commit: chore(prd): regenerate docs/prd/tatara-PRD.html ... post-fix regen: OK: idempotent, empty diff source .md check: OK: no source .md changes git status: clean ``` ## 6. Prevention (close the recurrence class) 1. **Single-commit rule.** Land generator-source changes and regenerated outputs in the same commit. Add it to the PR template / contributor docs. 2. **Regenerate in a pre-commit hook** so the artifact is staged automatically: ```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '^(scripts/merge-prd\.py|docs/prd/.*\.(md|html))$'; then source .venv/bin/activate python scripts/merge-prd.py git add docs/prd fi ``` Prefer a portable `pre-commit` config or a `make prd` / `uv run merge-prd` target. 3. **Expose a single entrypoint** (`make prd` or `scripts/merge-prd.py`) referenced by both CI and hooks, so "the generator" is one command everywhere. 4. **Keep the CI verify step on every PR** (no path filters that skip `docs/prd` or the generator). 5. **After any hosted-CI outage**, re-run the verify step on `main` before trusting merges that landed during the window. ## 7. Quick reference ```bash # diagnose source .venv/bin/activate python scripts/merge-prd.py && git --no-pager diff -- docs/prd # deterministic? git diff --stat -- 'docs/prd/*.md' # must be empty # fix python scripts/merge-prd.py git add docs/prd git commit -m "chore(prd): regenerate PRD artifacts from scripts/merge-prd.py" # verify python scripts/merge-prd.py && git diff --quiet -- docs/prd && echo OK gh run list --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ```

The failure is deterministic regeneration drift (nested-strong markup differences, 3 lines), not nondeterminism. Fix: run the repo's generator (scripts/merge-prd.py) in the project venv, verify git diff is limited to the generated artifacts (source .md byte-identical), commit the regenerated artifact, and confirm the exact-head CI run's verify step turns green.
